name: NAT64 / DNS64
description: NAT64 translation and DNS64 synthesis for IPv6-only networks. tayga, Debian's userspace NAT64 translator (no kernel module), maps a NAT64 prefix onto an IPv4 dynamic pool, and Unbound synthesises AAAA records so IPv6-only clients can reach IPv4-only hosts. Installing the plugin only places the packages: configuration is applied from the plugin page, where the translator and resolver configuration are validated and applied with rollback on failure (unbound-checkconf gates the DNS64 half, and the firewall compiler emits forwarding for the translator interface while the plugin is enabled).
